video.title: I Didn't Buy a Lamborghini... I Did This Instead

summary: Nick Huber recounts how he reinvested cash from refinancing a self-storage building into more facilities instead of spending it on personal purchases. He describes building storage operations with a partner, then adding affiliate income and equity stakes in Ari Cost Seg and Somewhere.com. He reports substantial but lumpy income and says most of his net worth remains in business and real-estate equity; he has not sold a business or property. The story highlights reinvesting in a business he understood, alongside the capital demands, physical workload and illiquidity involved.
